tbesh_html:
1) couple, pair, team, yoke
1a) couple, pair, span (usually of animals)
1b) acre
1b1) the amount of land a span of oxen could plow in one day

strongs_1890.strongs_def: hence, an acre (i.e. day's task for a yoke of cattle to plough)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: acre, couple, [idiom] together, two (donkeys), yoke (of oxen).
